name: Flandre's Quest
source:
Flandre Scarlet, the not-quite-sane little sister of Remilia, decides to visit her friends at the Hakurei Shrine, only to learn that Marisa's birthday is approaching. Thus, Flandre must figure out what to get her as a present... 

[From [url=http://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Flandre%27s_Quest]touhouwiki[/url]]
translation:
精神状态不太稳定的芙兰朵露·斯卡蕾特是蕾米莉亚的妹妹。她决定前往博丽神社拜访朋友，却得知雾雨魔理沙的生日即将到来。于是，芙兰朵露必须想出该送她什么礼物……

[译自 [url=http://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Flandre%27s_Quest]东方维基[/url]]
